purpose: Resolve global and Nigerian role evidence for every domain without assuming that a role belongs to one domain only.

global_esco.name: ESCO occupations and skills
global_esco.notes: Primary global occupation/skill spine; use preferred and non-preferred terms as normalized titles and aliases.

global_onet.name: O*NET 30.3 Database
global_onet.notes: US-economy source used as a global proxy for occupation descriptions, alternate titles, tasks and technology skills; do not label US counts as Nigerian demand.

global_isco.name: ILO ISCO-08
global_isco.notes: Use for internationally comparable occupation grouping and deduplication.

global_wef.name: World Economic Forum Future of Jobs 2025
global_wef.notes: Trend and emerging-role evidence, not a complete title dictionary.

global_sfia.name: SFIA 9
global_sfia.notes: Technology, data, cloud, software, architecture, service and digital-management role vocabulary.

global_nice.name: NIST NICE Workforce Framework
global_nice.notes: Cybersecurity work roles, tasks, knowledge and skills; use as a role framework, not as a Nigeria vacancy count.

global_supply_chain.name: ASCM supply-chain body of knowledge
global_supply_chain.notes: Supply-chain, planning, operations, inventory and procurement terminology.

global_cips.name: CIPS Global Standard for Procurement and Supply
global_cips.notes: Procurement, sourcing, supplier relationship and commercial supply role terminology.

global_project_management.name: Project Management Institute standards
global_project_management.notes: Project, programme, portfolio and delivery role terminology.

global_health.name: WHO health workforce resources
global_health.notes: Health occupation and workforce context; regulated titles still require Nigerian regulator confirmation.

global_fao.name: FAO agriculture and food systems resources
global_fao.notes: Agriculture, food, fisheries, forestry and natural-resource role context.

global_icao_iata.name: ICAO and IATA aviation standards
global_icao_iata.notes: Aviation operations, safety, airports, air cargo and airline role vocabulary.

global_imo_imarest.name: IMO and IMarEST maritime standards
global_imo_imarest.notes: Maritime, marine engineering, shipping and seafaring terminology.

global_built_environment.name: RICS built-environment and property standards
global_built_environment.notes: Surveying, valuation, property, construction and built-environment role terminology.

global_energy.name: SPE petroleum engineering competency resources
global_energy.notes: Oil, gas, drilling, production and energy technical role terminology.

global_nuclear.name: IAEA nuclear and radiation resources
global_nuclear.notes: Nuclear engineering, radiation science, medical physics and safety terminology.

global_unesco.name: UNESCO education, science and culture resources
global_unesco.notes: Education, research, libraries, archives, culture and science-sector role context.

global_creative.name: ScreenSkills creative-industry role profiles
global_creative.notes: Film, television, animation, games and production role profiles; supplement with ESCO/O*NET.

global_game_dev.name: International Game Developers Association resources
global_game_dev.notes: Game-development role vocabulary and industry context for the sparse Game Design domain.

global_xr.name: Khronos Group open standards
global_xr.notes: OpenXR, 3D graphics and real-time technology terminology for XR and immersive roles.

global_esports.name: Hitmarker esports and gaming jobs
global_esports.notes: Specialist live role signal for esports, gaming and creator-economy work; use carefully because coverage is selective.

global_music.name: IFPI global music-industry resources
global_music.notes: Music production, recording, publishing and creator-economy context.

global_wipo.name: WIPO intellectual-property resources
global_wipo.notes: Patent, trademark, copyright and technology-transfer terminology.

ng_jobberman.name: Jobberman Nigeria jobs
ng_jobberman.notes: Observed Nigerian vacancy titles, categories, locations and employers; store aggregates or derived title counts rather than republishing listings.

ng_myjobmag.name: MyJobMag Nigeria feeds
ng_myjobmag.notes: Nigerian job-title, employer and category signal; use feed terms as aliases and retain provenance.

ng_nbs.name: National Bureau of Statistics Nigeria Labour Force Survey
ng_nbs.notes: National employment, sector and labour-context evidence; not a replacement for role-level vacancy data.

ng_nbte.name: NBTE National Occupational Standards and curricula
ng_nbte.notes: Primary Nigerian source for technical, vocational, trade and technician role names and performance standards.

ng_nuc.name: National Universities Commission CCMAS and standards
ng_nuc.notes: Use to validate Nigerian university pathways feeding professional roles; do not treat curriculum titles as vacancy demand.

ng_cpn.name: Computer Professionals Registration Council of Nigeria
ng_cpn.notes: Computing profession standards, registration and local terminology.

ng_telecom.name: NCC and NITDA ICT ecosystem sources
ng_telecom.notes: Telecommunications, digital economy, ICT and technology-sector context.

ng_engineering.name: COREN and Nigerian Society of Engineers
ng_engineering.notes: Engineering registration, disciplines and local professional terminology.

ng_built_environment.name: Nigerian built-environment regulators and bodies
ng_built_environment.notes: Architecture, quantity surveying, surveying, town planning and real-estate role/licensing context.

ng_health.name: Nigerian health-profession regulators
ng_health.notes: Use the relevant council for regulated titles, scope of practice and licensure; vacancy evidence still comes from Nigerian job sources.

ng_finance.name: Nigerian finance and accounting bodies/regulators
ng_finance.notes: Accounting, banking, credit, capital markets, insurance and investment terminology; apply the relevant regulator per role.

ng_business.name: CIPM Nigeria and Nigerian Institute of Management
ng_business.notes: Human resources, management, administration and organisational role terminology.

ng_supply_chain.name: CILT Nigeria and Nigerian supply-chain bodies
ng_supply_chain.notes: Logistics, transport, procurement, inventory, supplier and supply-chain terminology. Verify body-specific scope before using a title as regulated.

ng_legal.name: Nigerian Bar Association and legal regulators
ng_legal.notes: Legal practice, immigration, intellectual property, compliance and regulated legal titles.

ng_education.name: NUC, NCCE and Nigerian education standards
ng_education.notes: Teaching, research, higher education, vocational and early-learning pathway context.

ng_agriculture.name: Nigerian agriculture, food and veterinary authorities
ng_agriculture.notes: Agriculture, food, livestock, fisheries and veterinary naming; use job boards for current openings.

ng_energy.name: Nigerian upstream, midstream and downstream energy regulators
ng_energy.notes: Oil, gas, energy, process and offshore role terminology.

ng_aviation_maritime.name: Nigerian aviation and maritime authorities
ng_aviation_maritime.notes: Aviation, airport, maritime, marine engineering and shipping context.

ng_creative.name: Nigerian creative-industry and media sources
ng_creative.notes: Journalism, media, film, music, copyright and creative-production context.

ng_gaming.name: National Lottery Regulatory Commission and Nigerian gaming ecosystem
ng_gaming.notes: Gaming, betting and lottery regulation; pair with live vacancy sources for actual titles.

ng_environment.name: NESREA and Nigerian environmental regulators
ng_environment.notes: Environmental engineering, climate, occupational safety and environmental compliance context.

cross_domain_role_policy.canonical_role_rule: Create one canonical role record and attach domain_ids; do not create a separate role merely because the same title appears under another domain.
cross_domain_role_policy.primary_domain_rule: Choose the domain that best describes the role's principal work output; use secondary domains for material adjacent responsibilities.

example_third_party_cybersecurity.canonical_role_family: Third-party cyber risk and supplier security
example_third_party_cybersecurity.notes: Third party, vendor and supplier are aliases. The supply-chain link is valid when the role owns supplier governance, procurement assurance or vendor lifecycle controls; the cyber link remains primary when the work is security due diligence, control assessment or cyber risk.

sparse_domain_policy.rule: Sparse posting volume is not evidence that the domain has no roles. Use specialist industry sources plus ESCO/O*NET/ISCO for the role spine, and label Nigerian evidence as limited when Jobberman/MyJobMag do not produce a stable sample.
minimum_evidence: one specialist global industry source where available
one Nigerian regulator/industry source where available

implementation_notes: Resolve the source set for a domain by unioning default_sources, the domain cluster rule and domain_overrides.
Use evidence_type to keep role-title evidence separate from labour-market context and professional/licensing context.
Store source_id and checked_at on every normalized role observation; source URL alone is not sufficient provenance.
This registry intentionally does not copy role names from role_library_v3; it is driven by domain_meta and source families, then used to collect or validate role names.
Validate that every key in domain_meta.json resolves to at least one global/global_proxy source and both ng_jobberman and ng_myjobmag.
